meta.title: Nove Labs — biomarkers, on a schedule.
meta.description: A blood-test membership for healthspan. Comprehensive quarterly panels with AI interpretation and biomarkers tracked over time.

hero.headline: Biomarkers, on a schedule.
hero.subheadline: A blood-test membership built for healthspan. Comprehensive quarterly panels, AI interpretation, biomarkers tracked over time — not just a snapshot every few years.

items.title: 100+ biomarkers per panel
items.description: Lipids, glucose, thyroid, hormones, inflammation, vitamins, kidney and liver function. The full healthspan panel — not just the basics your doctor checks once a year.

items.title: Quarterly cadence, by default
items.description: Four panels a year, on a schedule. Healthspan is about catching drift early — and you can't catch drift with a snapshot every five years.

items.title: Trends, not single points
items.description: Every biomarker plotted across panels. The number that matters is rarely today's — it's the direction over the last 12 months.

items.title: AI coach grounded in your panels
items.description: An AI agent specialized for health records — ask 'why is my LDL elevated?', compare panels, dig into trends. After each new panel, the coach tells you what specifically to focus on for the next quarter.

testimonials.quote: Continuous data from wearable sensors provides a rich, granular, high-definition view of each person's health — and that changes everything.
testimonials.name: Dr. Eric Topol
testimonials.role: Cardiologist, founder of Scripps Research Translational Institute

testimonials.quote: The opportunity with sensors, data, and AI is to move us from being intermittent and reactive to being continuous and proactive.
testimonials.name: Dr. Daniel Kraft
testimonials.role: Founder of NextMed Health, faculty chair for Medicine at Singularity University

testimonials.quote: P4 medicine — predictive, preventive, personalized, participatory — is proactive instead of reactive. It's about wellness, not just disease.
testimonials.name: Dr. Leroy Hood
testimonials.role: Co-founder of the Institute for Systems Biology, pioneer of systems medicine

security.headline: Health data deserves the highest bar.
security.subheadline: Your blood test results are the most personal data you have. We treat them that way — at the architecture level, not just in fine print.

points.title: Encrypted by default
points.description: All results — current and historical panels — encrypted at rest and in transit. Continuous audits and patches, not one-time checkboxes.

points.title: Certified partner labs only
points.description: Panels run by accredited clinical labs with audited chains of custody. No corner-cutting on the actual chemistry.

points.title: Never sold, never shared
points.description: No advertising partnerships, no third-party data sales, no 'aggregated and de-identified' fine print. Your results stay inside Nove.

points.title: You own your data
points.description: Export everything to CSV or PDF in one click. Delete everything in one click. Share with your doctor in one click — on your terms, not ours.

footerCta.headline: Stop guessing at your healthspan.
footerCta.subheadline: Labs is launching soon. Join the waitlist for early access.
